pwa.install_ios_title: Add Fandez to your Home Screen
pwa.install_android_body: Install it as an app for quick access — no store needed.
pwa.install_ios_body: On iPhone it isn’t downloaded from a store. Add it from Safari in 3 steps:
pwa.install_manual_body: Open your browser menu and choose Install app.
pwa.ios_toolbar_hint: The Share button is in the Safari bar, bottom center (square with ↑).
pwa.ios_step1: Tap Share in the Safari bar.
pwa.ios_step2: Scroll and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.ios_step3: Confirm “Add”. Fandez will open like an app.
pwa.ios_step1_html: At the bottom of Safari, tap the Share icon.
pwa.ios_step2_html: Scroll and choose Add to Home Screen.
pwa.ios_step3_html: Confirm Add. Fandez will stay as an app.
pwa.android_step1: Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right in Chrome.
pwa.android_step2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
pwa.android_step3: Confirm. Fandez will sit with your other apps.
pwa.android_step1_html: Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right in Chrome.
pwa.android_step2_html: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
pwa.android_step3_html: Confirm. Fandez will sit with your other apps.
pwa.inapp_body: WhatsApp and other in-app browsers can’t install it. Open it in Safari, then add it to your Home Screen.
pwa.inapp_step1: Tap ⋯ or Share at the top right.
pwa.inapp_step2: Choose “Open in Safari” (iPhone) or “Open in Chrome” (Android).
pwa.inapp_step3: Then tap Install app on your phone again.
pwa.inapp_step1_html: Tap ⋯ or the share icon at the top right.
pwa.inapp_step2_html: Choose Open in Safari (iPhone) or Open in Chrome (Android).
pwa.inapp_step3_html: In the browser, tap Install app on your phone again.
landing.partner_body: Get verified requests in your area, earn with backing and build a client base that values punctuality, quality and professional service.
about.title: Service with punctuality, excellence and heart
about.slogan: On time, with care, for those who need it most
about.image_alt: Plumber smiling with an elderly woman at her home after completing a repair
about.image_caption: Every visit is a promise kept: arrive on time, work with respect, and leave peace of mind in every home.
about.mission_body: Fandez was created to connect Santiago homes with verified technicians who deliver punctual, transparent and human service. We believe fixing a faucet, outlet or pipe is not just a repair — it is restoring peace of mind to a family, a grandmother alone at home, or anyone who trusts us when they need it most.
about.pillar_time_body: We coordinate every visit with precision so the technician arrives when promised.
about.pillar_quality_body: Verified work, respectful treatment and clear standards on every service.
about.pillar_community_body: We serve neighborhoods, families and neighbors with a commitment to care for what matters most: the home.
about.promise_body: Behind every request is a person waiting for a solution. That is why we built a platform the community can trust:
about.promise_1: Verified technicians and partners before attending any service
about.promise_2: Real-time tracking for families and beneficiaries
about.promise_3: Clear, human support when something does not go as expected
about.promise_4: A service standard that honors those who open their home to us
